label: DR-005
note: A property that throws InvalidOperationException when accessed without satisfying the guard is intentional defensive programming; reviewer must NOT flag the throwing property as an anti-pattern or suggest removing the exception.

known_false_positive.title: Property getters should not throw exceptions
known_false_positive.why_it_matters: FileName and BlobKey throw from their getters, which is an anti-pattern: serializers, debuggers and data binding read properties freely and will crash. Return null or expose a TryGetFileName method instead.
